sectionDescription: Real coaching clients. Real offers. Verify every review yourself.

verifyBanner.text: Don't trust fake reviews. Click to verify every testimonial below.

successStories.name: Vaughn
successStories.coachReply: Vaughn landed a role at DraftKings after our coaching session. Appreciate the kind note. Wishing you continued success!

successStories.name: Ann
successStories.review: This was my >2 times with Rupesh for mock interview! He holds a very high bar and treats each mock interview as seriously as if it were his own team's hiring process. The session was incredibly valuable, and I truly believe his guidance will help me ace the interview!
successStories.coachReply: Your dedication and progress are inspiring — I'm truly honored to be part of your journey. Wishing you all the best for the final panel!

successStories.name: Andre
successStories.review: I had a prep session with Rupesh for my Amazon interview. His experience as an Amazon Solutions Architect shows in his coaching. Rupesh gave clear feedback on my technical answers and communication style, spotting weaknesses I missed. I recommend Rupesh to anyone preparing for a technical interview.
successStories.coachReply: I don't do generic coaching — I focus on what actually works in real Amazon interviews.

successStories.name: Shiv
successStories.review: I had the opportunity to interview with Rupesh for the Senior Site Reliability Engineer role. The session was very engaging, he created a comfortable environment. His questions focused not only on technical depth but also on collaboration, ownership, and leadership.
successStories.coachReply: Glad the session helped you sharpen both the technical and leadership side of your prep. Wishing you the best with Google!

successStories.name: Ca
successStories.review: I took multiple sessions with Rupesh and have consistently been impressed by his deep expertise in DevOps and the AWS cloud domain. He is genuinely passionate about his work and goes above and beyond to support his students. I highly recommend him for coaching in Java, DevOps, Cloud (AWS), and SRE domains.

successStories.name: Bijan
successStories.review: A fantastic call. I learned a huge amount of practical and valuable information. I now have a clear, structured plan towards my interviews.
successStories.coachReply: You asked sharp questions and leaned into the frameworks fast — that's why you left with a clear plan. Most people walk into TPM interviews unstructured; you're already fixing that.

successStories.name: Melvin
successStories.review: Rupesh was amazing to work with. As a beginning Solutions Architect, I was stuck in my career, and he provided guidance for sharpening my skills, demonstrating competence, building my brand. By the end of the session, I had a 90-day step-by-step plan to turn my career around.
